title: accuchek JSON output (format 2)
description: Readings downloaded from a Roche Accu-Chek meter, with the meter identity, its clock and the announced/received counters. 'timestamp' is the time shown by the meter; 'epoch' is that time read in the PC time zone, daylight saving time included (mktime with tm_isdst=-1). Written only when the exit code is 0; otherwise stdout is empty and stderr holds 'accuchek: <reason>'.

announced.description: number of entries announced by the meter, null if it does not describe its segments

unmatched.description: meal markers with no reading at the same second

meter.description: identity announced by the meter (MDS attributes), null if it announces none

model.description: Roche model number, 925 for a Guide

clock.description: meter clock read at the start of the session, before any --set-time

pc_synchronized.description: PC clock synchronized (NTP); never copied to the meter otherwise

meal.description: meal marker segment, null if the meter has none

status.description: raw status from the meter; 0 for a normal reading

error.description: unreadable reading ("invalid date": invalid BCD date), epoch and timestamp are then null

range.description: off-scale reading (HI / LO on the meter)

meal.description: marker entered on the meter, absent without a marker
